name: Kerry Properties Limited
summary: Kerry Properties Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the development, investment, management, and trading of properties in Hong Kong, Mainland China, and internationally. The company owns and operates residences, apartments, hotels, shopping malls, and office towers; real estate and project management; and provides integrated logistics and international freight forwarding, consultancy, administrative support, project management, financial, estate agency, and construction services. It is also involved in the warehouse operations, as well as recreation parks, and ice rinks. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Quarry Bay, Hong Kong.
